opennyai_summary.decision:
1. By virtue of an award dated 20.05.2025 in a claim petition bearing file No.59/2023 instituted on 13.07.2023 preferred by the respondents No.1 to 4, the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal (MACT)
(District Judge), Ramban has awarded compensation for an amount of Rs.1,07,32,638/- along with interest in favour of the said respondents/claimants which has left the appellant being insurer of the offending vehicle bearing No.JK03D/4140 to come forward with the present time barred appeal under section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1973 accompanied with an application-CM No.8473/2025 seeking condonation of delay of 117 days on the basis of cause being pleaded that the award was modified by virtue of later dated 05.06.2025.
3. For the reason cited in the application, involving the official consultation at the end of the appellant company, this Court is inclined to allow the application.
4. Application is allowed by condoning the delay.
5. The appeal is taken on record.
Appellant to furnish registered postal covers within a period of seven (7) days whereupon notice to go to the respondents.
Operation of impugned award shall come to stay.
10. The appellant is, however, directed to deposit entire compensation amount along with updated interest within six (6) weeks with the Registrar Judicial, Jammu whereupon the same is to be kept in Fixed Deposit for a period of three months extending on its own unless and until the order to the contrary.
